Bash(gh pr create --title "Voice-guided auto-save for elderly users" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

Adds voice-guided auto-save functionality designed for elderly users \(85+ years old, nearly blind\) who need audio guidance throughout the conversation experience.

### Features

- **Tiered silence detection with voice prompts**:
  - 30 seconds: Gentle check-in \("Take your time. I'm here when you're ready."\)
  - 60 seconds: Save offer \("Would you like me to save this story? Just say 'save'..."\)
  - 90 seconds: Auto-save and announce \("I've saved your story as a draft...""\)

- **Voice command recognition**:
  - ""Save"" / ""Save my story"" → Save and confirm
  - ""Done"" / ""I'm done" / "Finished" → Save and end
  - "Goodbye" / "Bye Ember" → Save, thank them, end session

- **Auto-draft saving**:
  - Save to localStorage every 30 seconds
  - Save to Supabase after each AI response
  - Nothing ever lost, even if browser closes

## Tasks

- [x] Add silence detection with tiered voice prompts
- [ ] Add voice command recognition \(save/done/goodbye\)
- [ ] Add auto-draft saving to localStorage
- [ ] Add auto-draft saving to Supabase
- [ ] Integrate with conversation page
- [ ] Test end-to-end

## Test Plan

- [ ] Start conversation, wait 30 seconds - Ember should speak gentle check-in
- [ ] Wait 60 seconds total - Ember should offer to save
- [ ] Wait 90 seconds total - Ember should auto-save and announce
- [ ] Say "save my story" - should save immediately
- [ ] Say "goodbye" - should save and end session
- [ ] Close browser mid-conversation, reopen - draft should be recoverable

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
